title: BugStr Crash Report Payload
description: Schema for crash report payloads sent by BugStr SDKs. All SDKs MUST produce payloads conforming to this schema.

message.description: The exception message or error description. MUST NOT be empty.

stack.description: Full stack trace as a single string with newlines. Use the platform's native format (Java 'at' frames, Dart '#N' frames, JS 'at' frames). Do NOT strip or truncate — the receiver handles grouping.

release.description: Application version string (e.g., '1.0.0+42', '2.3.1-beta'). Used for symbolication lookup and release health tracking.

app_id.description: Application identifier (e.g., 'com.example.myapp', 'org.example.app'). Used for symbolication mapping file lookup.

platform.description: Platform identifier. Used to select the correct symbolicator.
